done_when: When Codex isn't installed, forge close runs Autoreview with --engine claude on [models.grill.claude]'s model and effort, finding the Autoreview helper under the Claude or Codex skills folder; forge doctor accepts a Claude-only setup; a test runs forge close with no codex command and sees the Claude review used

findings.body: The helper search stops at the first existing file, then checks its pin. If ~/.codex has an outdated Autoreview helper and ~/.claude has the pinned helper, forge close rejects the Codex copy instead of using the valid Claude copy. Select the first pinned standard helper.
findings.title: Use a valid Claude helper when an older Codex helper is present

findings.body: The engine choice also affects client sign-off. review.signoff() at review.py:315 calls run() with a config containing only models.review. Without Codex, this line requests models.grill.claude, so repo.models() at repo.py:213–217 refuses before Autoreview runs. A Claude-only team can close an ordinary fix but cannot accept client sign-off.
findings.title: Keep client sign-off review working without Codex

why: Reviews always run on Codex, so a team with only Claude Code installed can't close any work
